records.title: Talk, See, Support (TSS): A Wearable Multimodal, Intelligent, Agentic LLM-Powered Construction Assistant for Real-Time On-Site Guidance and Compliance Monitoring
records.reason: The official NJIT repository abstract describes a wearable construction assistant that streams audio/vision to cloud LLM/RAG for guidance; it is an application system and reports no LLM inference-efficiency method.

records.title: Broadcast-and-Mixing Transformer for 3D Semantic Segmentation
records.reason: The abstract concerns point-cloud 3D semantic segmentation with a broadcast-and-mixing Transformer, not language-model inference.

records.title: Real-time NLP moderation on XMPP with GPU-accelerated inference and adaptive batching
records.reason: Abstract: adaptive batching and GPU-accelerated transformer moderation are directly relevant to LLM serving. The primary full text could not be retrieved for mechanism/evaluation verification.

records.title: Artificial intelligence-driven resource management in edge-cloud computing continuum for internet of things applications: new trends and future directions
records.reason: The primary abstract is an edge-cloud IoT resource-management review spanning broad AI scheduling; foundation-model integration is only an emerging topic, not an LLM inference/serving contribution.

records.title: A Hybrid Method for Semantic Cache Analysis of Computational Kernels in C Programs
records.reason: The abstract concerns semantic cache analysis for computational kernels in C programs; its target is source-level CPU cache analysis, not LLM serving.
